item.title: GDP report to give insight before Election Day. And, Israel's election is deadlocked
item.description: Economists expect the GDP report to show economic growth, but say that growth is "fragile." And, after 90% of the votes in Israel have been counted, no clear winner has emerged.

item.title: How AI drones are influencing the course of the Ukraine war
item.description: Artificial intelligence is making drones faster and more capable. Russia and Ukraine both use AI-powered drones, and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has warned that AI could lead decisions on the battlefield as soon as next year.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Spain reckons with 2nd deadly train crash of the year ahead of national election
item.description: Spain's second high-speed rail disaster this year, a crash in which one train struck another from behind, killing 68 people, has raised fresh concerns about the safety of the country's rail network.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Brazilian political drama unfolds as defeated Flavio Bolsonaro arrives in Miami
item.description: Defeated presidential candidate Flavio Bolsonaro and his family have arrived in the U.S. after Brazilian authorities ordered him to surrender his passport. He is facing multiple investigations in Brazil.

item.title: Israel's election too close to call. And, the Ebola outbreak reaches grim milestone
item.description: Israeli voters turned out in record numbers, and the results remain too close to call. And, more than 10,000 people have been infected with Ebola since the outbreak was first declared in May.

item.title: Dozens are dead in a high-speed train crash in Spain
item.description: The toll is rising after a high-speed train between slammed into the rear of another train that had stopped south of Madrid, derailing two cars. It was Spain's second major train accident this year.

item.description: President Trump's relationship with Russia's Vladimir Putin is under scrutiny again as the president makes deals with Moscow ahead of the midterms.

item.title: Partial results from Israel's contentious election show no clear winner
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's right-wing bloc was leading opposition rival Gadi Eisenkot. Arab parties had a strong showing, and a key question now is whether Eisenkot's bloc will consider forming a coalition with them.

item.title: A U.S. cruise ship suspends a global voyage due to fuel costs, stranding 200 passengers
item.description: A U.S. cruise ship on an around-the-world voyage that touted its cabins as floating homes suspended its three-year journey in Cambodia due to fuel costs, forcing hundreds of passengers to disembark.
